purpose: Test whether conservative recurrent corrections can improve strict safe completion of frozen Jar pi0.5 on development tasks.
current_authorization: Write the next experiment and future goal prompt; rent and prepare one Vast GPU for at most ten hours; do not start the experiment.

implementation_status.conservative_mutations_native_anchor_con: Implemented; 33 software tests passed on the previous rented host; no v3 robot rollouts.
implementation_status.selection_stage: Required before launch; current runner still exports its distribution mean.
implementation_status.runtime_configuration: Generate a fresh executable config from this protocol and the new rental receipt after implementation; this protocol is not a runner config.

scientific_scope.prior_result: Version 2: 0/48 strict safe completions across sampled training candidates versus native 5/8; final selected 0/6 versus native 1/6. Engagement was reduced.
scientific_scope.hypothesis: Smaller perturbations, a native candidate, informative safe progress and measured controller selection will preserve engagement and expose a completion lever.

execution.original_monitor: Passive labels only; no veto or environment modification.

controller.initial_controller: Fresh seeded hidden state weights with exactly zero output layer, producing native commands; do not warm-start from failed v2 controller.

training.fitness: For n valid cases: (4*n+2)*strict_safe_completions + sum(safe_stage_progress + 0.25*safe_target_contact) - raw_violation_episodes/(n+1). Invalid panels are ineligible.
training.stage_progress: 0 none; 1 closure while supported; 2 ten consecutive closed/grasped controls after closure; 3 a support-departure transition after stage 2 while closed and grasped. A raw violation or invalid closure-before-departure order removes auxiliary credit.
training.contact_credit: Contact must occur while supported, upright and not dropped, with no raw violation and a valid closure-before-departure prefix. Movement alone earns no credit.
training.order: Seeded candidate permutation; alternate separate native-reference panel placement by generation. Preserve all 12 native-anchor and 12 separate native-reference episodes distinctly.

selection.elite_rule: Maximize recorded training fitness among non-anchor candidates; exact ties use earliest generation then lowest candidate index. This only nominates a candidate for fresh selection evaluation.
selection.order: For the four task/seed cases in task-major order, rotate [native, elite, mean] left by case index modulo 3. Evaluate all three slots even if parameter vectors coincide.
selection.admissibility: An adapter is eligible only if its selection-panel strict safe completion count exceeds the native count.
selection.winner: Among eligible adapters maximize the same v3 fitness over all four selection cases; an exact tie prefers the evaluated elite. If none qualifies, return native unchanged.

validation.order: Task-major then seed-major; alternate native-first and selected-first by case index.
validation.native_fallback_interpretation: If selection returns native, label selected as a repeated native control; differences cannot be attributed to an evolved intervention.

limits.deadline_source: Actual new rental receipt; absolute and unchanged by resume, delayed launch or setup.
limits.unknown_bootstrap_physics: Retain as unknown; do not assume zero or hide it inside control-step counts.
limits.technical_or_time_stop: Save all evidence and mark incomplete. Do not change panels, seeds, population, objectives or the selected controller from validation outcomes. No new rental or deadline extension is authorized.

events: First later departure while closed and grasped
diagnostics.unfinished_stage: Farthest valid ordered stage reached, retaining event order and reason for any invalid prefix.
action_metrics: Native versus modified versus executed commands

analysis.primary: Strict safe completions with closure before carry, n=6 per validation arm.
also_report: Simulator steps, physics counters and model queries
Model-query time and elapsed wall time separately
analysis.interpretation: A non-native selected controller with more fresh validation strict safe completions is a development signal, not replicated superiority. Lower violations with inactivity do not establish a lever.
analysis.optimizer_controls: Native, tuned fixed, parameter random search and ordinary learning with identical information and matched interactions remain required for a later evolutionary-advantage comparison; they are not added to this allocation.
